verdict.rationale: turbopuffer is driven through a documented public API. Its API overview covers auth tokens and async operations, it documents write, query and namespace endpoints, and it ships official SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, Ruby and Rust. It also publishes a public OpenAPI spec in an official repo. The root-path OpenAPI probe 404s do not contradict this, because the spec lives in the GitHub repo. Missing for 10: a stable OpenAPI contract (the README says the spec is primarily internal and may make breaking changes at any time), independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.
